rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIcapinal
Exhibition name: Pink Panther ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1981).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1981 as 'Pink Panther'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1985 as 'Pink Panther'.
rows.Bloom: Pink - silver(y), deep pink edges. Moderate, fruity, sweet fragrance. up to 40 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
